firstRun.title: Get this server ready
firstRun.subtitle: The steps a new server needs before it is doing its job.

plan.title: Create a hosting plan
plan.description: The standard plans are ready-made. Add your own to set the limits you sell.

account.title: Create a hosting account
account.description: An account is a customer's space on this server, with its own login and limits.

site.title: Add a site
site.description: A site connects a domain to an account's files.

backupDestination.title: Choose where backups go
backupDestination.description: Add a destination other than this server's own disk, or save a backup schedule.

certificate.title: Issue a site certificate
certificate.description: A certificate puts a site on HTTPS.
